title: Your Daily Digest
prompt: Design a fictional webapp-settings example for this task: Keep urgent mentions visible. Gather routine messages into one delivery. A single-column settings form sits in a white sheet on a dark field; a compact selected-time strip replaces the tall clock and duplicated policy. Preserve the supplied data, keyboard controls, recovery actions and local-only behavior. Use Office Code Pro and a #17363C page with #254E54 accents.
